questions.q_en: If sin [20+ x]° = cos 60°, 0° ≤ [20 + x]° ≤ 90°, then find the value of 2sin2 [3x + 15]° - cosec2[2x + 10]°.
questions.q_hi: यदि sin [20+ x]° = cos 60°, 0° ≤ [20 + x]° ≤ 90°, तो 2sin2[3x + 15]° - cosec2[2x + 10]° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution_en:
If A + B = 90° then Sin A = Cos B
[20 + x]° + 60° = 90°
x = 10°
= 2 sin245°-cosec230°
= 2× -4
= 1-4
= -3
